appearance: Floating violet freshwater jellyfish with a translucent bell, white rim spots and three broad trailing tendrils; solid readable pixel clusters.

motions.stand: Hover facing left, violet bell contracts inward then opens fully, three broad tendrils curl and uncurl in a staggered pulse, return to the original hovering pose. Keep solid pixel clusters and no background water.
motions.move: Facing left, strong bell contraction and release propels an in-place swimming cycle, three tendrils stream backward then relax under the bell, body pitches left without whole-image translation.
motions.attack1: Facing left, contract the violet bell tightly, draw three tendrils under the body, then flare the bell rim and point all three tendrils toward the left in a focused casting pulse, return to hover. No baked projectile.
motions.hit1: Facing left, bell flinches inward asymmetrically and broad tendrils retract defensively, recover bell shape and the original hover.
motions.die1: Facing left, bell loses lift and folds softly onto the ground while all three tendrils curl loosely beneath it, white rim spots dim, finish motionless but still recognizable, no dissolve.
